title: Ember Orchard: The Diplomat's Seed Archive
premise: In a volcanic garden whose fruit germinates in cooling ash, the diplomat must negotiate a route across a disputed threshold using a sealed bilingual accord.
ending: Recover the Seed Archive and return with the mutual passage covenant; Orchard Keepers can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive thermal surge while evading the ashwood guardian without sacrificing the mutual passage covenant.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Orchard Keepers to witness the sealed bilingual accord.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to reveal the faction's old promise
